clinical_warnings.title: CRITICAL PHARMACOPEIA (SGLT2i / Jardiance)
clinical_warnings.message: CRITICAL PHARMACOPEIA (SGLT2i / Jardiance): Induces osmotic glucosuria. Daily carbohydrate intake is strictly protected at >= 130g/day with >= 2.5L daily hydration to eliminate Euglycemic DKA risk. Extreme low-carb or fasting regimens are contraindicated.

clinical_warnings.title: DRUG INTERACTION WARNING (Calcium Channel Blocker / Amlodipine)
clinical_warnings.message: DRUG INTERACTION WARNING (Calcium Channel Blocker / Amlodipine): Grapefruit, pomelo, and Seville oranges are 100% eliminated from this plan. Their furanocoumarins irreversibly inhibit gut CYP3A4, causing massive drug over-absorption and severe hypotension.

clinical_warnings.title: ELECTROLYTE ALERT (ACEi / ARB)
clinical_warnings.message: ELECTROLYTE ALERT (ACEi / ARB): Renin-angiotensin blockade reduces renal potassium clearance. Daily potassium is capped at <= 2000-2400 mg/d. High-potassium salt substitutes (potassium chloride) and concentrated potassium drinks (e.g., coconut water) are restricted.

clinical_warnings.title: DIGESTIVE PACING (GLP-1 RA)
clinical_warnings.message: DIGESTIVE PACING (GLP-1 RA): Gastric emptying is slowed. Daily calories are split evenly across 5 modest intervals and high-fat items are restricted to prevent nausea, reflux, and gastroparesis.

clinical_warnings.title: METABOLIC STABILITY (Metformin)
clinical_warnings.message: METABOLIC STABILITY (Metformin): All main intervals feature high-fiber complex carbohydrates to minimize gastrointestinal discomfort and maintain smooth glycemic control.

clinical_warnings.title: HEMODYNAMIC MONITORING (Beta-Blocker)
clinical_warnings.message: HEMODYNAMIC MONITORING (Beta-Blocker): Maintain steady complex carbohydrate pacing across morning and lunch intervals to avoid blunting of hypoglycemia awareness.

clinical_warnings.title: CYP3A4 PHARMACOPEIA (Statin)
clinical_warnings.message: CYP3A4 PHARMACOPEIA (Statin): Grapefruit and related citrus are omitted to prevent statin accumulation, rhabdomyolysis, and myopathy.

clinical_warnings.title: ELECTROLYTE & FLUID MONITORING (Diuretic)
clinical_warnings.message: ELECTROLYTE & FLUID MONITORING (Diuretic): Renal electrolyte wasting or potassium sparing is active. Maintain steady fluid pacing and monitor serum electrolytes routinely.

clinical_warnings.title: COAGULATION WARNING (Warfarin)
clinical_warnings.message: COAGULATION WARNING (Warfarin): Vitamin K intake from dark leafy greens (spinach, kale, methi) must remain consistent day-to-day to avoid destabilizing INR and prothrombin time.

clinical_warnings.title: GLYCEMIC SAFETY (Insulin)
clinical_warnings.message: GLYCEMIC SAFETY (Insulin): Carbohydrate portions are precision-calculated across all intervals to prevent nocturnal and postprandial hypoglycemia.
